Class DelayNotices

java.lang.Object
ecmwf.ecpds.master.plugin.http.controller.monitoring.DelayNotices
public final class DelayNotices extends Object
ECMWF Product Data Store (OpenECPDS) Project The register of the delay notices, kept in the DELAY_NOTICE table of the database (see the Master's DataBaseImpl). The status, creation and version are columns; everything else is a JSON document. References (DLY-YYYY-NNNN) are allocated atomically by the Master, so several Monitors can register notices at the same time, and modifications use optimistic locking (the version column) so that two operators changing the same notice cannot overwrite each other. Notices are kept until an operator deletes them.

    • modify

      public static Map<String,Object> modify(String ref, DelayNotices.Change change) throws Exception
      Modifies a notice atomically: the notice is read, changed by the given function and written back only if nobody changed it in the meantime, otherwise the whole operation is retried on the fresh version.
      Parameters:
      ref - the reference
      change - the change (it may throw IllegalArgumentException to refuse it and, being possibly run again, must not have side effects)
      Returns:
      the notice after the change
      Throws:
      Exception - if the notice is unknown, the change is refused or it cannot be saved
